qpe.artifact_rule: cell above 100 mm/h in 4+ hours read or above 150 mm/h in 3+ hours: removed from all statistics
qpe.definition: MRMS hourly QPE, gauge corrected Pass 2 where available; rolling 1, 3, 6 h windows ending t0 .. t1 + 1 h

ari.definition: FLASH QPE_ARI 1H, 3H, 6H at the top of each hour t0 .. t1 + 1 h, pixel maximum over the episode; years, capped at 200

flash.definition: FLASH products at the top of each hour t0 .. t1 + 1 h over the episode footprint; per cell peak over those hours; cov1 = share of the area whose peak QPE/FFG ratio reached 1.0 (cos latitude weighted)
